rationale: The MIN conjunction is a legitimate non-linear composite, but the two ingredients are near-textbook cash-based profitability (Novy-Marx) and abnormal capital investment (Titman-Wei-Xie), so the signal risks being little more than a double-sort of two known anomalies with modest incremental content.

The expression matches the stated conditional hypothesis and the profitability×investment interaction is economically motivated (q-theory implies exactly this), but multiplying a non-negative IND_RANK by a 0/1 indicator dumps all below-median-profitability firms into the bottom of the signal distribution, contaminating the short leg with a heterogeneous mass point rather than cleanly isolating low-growth profitable firms.

A genuinely cross-theme construct — realized profit growth benchmarked against the firm's own prior committed capacity growth — that is internally consistent and not a repackaging of a standard investment or profitability anomaly, though the unwinsorized growth ratios (especially oibdp with small or negative bases) and the mass point at zero for non-expanders need careful handling.

Scaling acquisition spend by internally generated cash rather than assets is a defensible refinement of the acquirer-underperformance and investment literature, but the oancf>0 filter binds on the large majority of firms so the "conditional" framing is largely cosmetic, and aqc is zero or missing for most firm-years, which will concentrate the signal in a thin, unstable subsample.

Positive gross profit is true for nearly all firms, so the "conditional" wrapper is essentially vacuous and the signal reduces to an inventory-change measure — a direct rediscovery of the well-documented inventory growth anomaly (Thomas-Zhang; Belo-Lin) with only a scaling variation.

With ib>0 for the majority of firm-years the conditioning adds little, leaving (capx − oancf)/at, which is simply negated free cash flow scaled by assets and is already spanned by the external-financing, accruals, and investment anomalies; the hypothesized "narrative vulnerability" story is not distinguishable from those known effects by this expression.
